_doc: Weapons and weapon mastery (arms.gd, sim.arms). Each weapon in `weapons` is open to the tribe while its `when` holds (conditions as in scenario scripts: usually the invention that makes it; {} = always). kind melee: struck at `reach`, a blow every `cd` seconds; kind ranged: shot from up to `range`, stepping back when a foe comes within `keep` (hunt.gd shoots). atk: multiplies the wielder's attack. crit: added to the chance of a critical blow. needs: {skill: level} the wielder must have (aiming takes a hunter's eye). rating: how good the weapon is when people choose which to carry. act: what they are doing with it. start_skill: people start with this weapon's mastery at that skill's level (the club, everyone's first weapon).

weapons.name: Club
weapons.desc: A knotted branch: everyone's first weapon.

weapons.name: Spear
weapons.desc: A fire-hardened point on a long shaft: strikes from a step farther and harder.

weapons.name: Stone Axe
weapons.desc: A hafted stone head: slow, but every blow tells.

weapons.name: Sling
weapons.desc: Stones hurled from afar, out of a beast's reach.

weapons.name: Bow
weapons.desc: A bent stave and a sinew string: shoots farther and harder than the sling.

mastery._doc: Mastery of each weapon rises with use, like a skill: the XP from level lv to the next is xp_base + xp_per_lv x lv, up to max_lv. XP: blow_xp a blow or shot, kill_xp a kill, hunt_xp a deer brought down with it (all times the person's talent for the weapon). Each level: atk_per_lv more attack, cd_per_lv quicker blows (at most cd_max off), crit_per_lv more critical blows. Reaching master_lv makes them a master of that weapon (log, memory, the tribe's first master of each weapon is an achievement). popup (a level: weapon, level), log (person, weapon), remember (weapon, day), title (the achievement: weapon): texts.
mastery.remember: became a master of the %s on Day %d
mastery.title: The first master of the %s

talent._doc: Everyone has a knack for each weapon, fixed from birth (rolled from the person, not the game's dice): a value between min and max, and with gifted_chance a gift instead (gifted). traits: a person's first trait multiplies it per weapon. The knack multiplies the XP they get with it, and how keen they are to carry it. words: how the sheet names a knack (the first whose `at` it reaches, from the top).
